v.text: Pidilite Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
v.summary: Pidilite Industries Limited has intimated the schedule of analyst and institutional investor meetings pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations. On 17 November 2026, from 10.00 am to 01.00 pm, the company will hold a group meeting with Avendus Spark INDX Annual Investor Conference in Mumbai via physical conference. On 18 November 2026, from 08.30 pm to 09.30 pm, a single institutional virtual meeting with Aristotle Capital will take place in Mumbai. The company notes that dates are subject to change due to exigencies. This information is also hosted on the company website at www.pidilite.com.
